t: A small desktop robot arm with a gripper for learning ROS 2.
steps: Buy the arm kit from the ROBOTIS US store or a robot shop.
Also buy a 12 volt power supply, a U2D2 adapter or OpenCR board, and a base plate.
Assemble the arm with the Robotis e-Manual quick start guide.
Install Ubuntu 24.04 and ROS 2 Jazzy on a PC, or use the Docker setup Robotis recommends.
Download the open_manipulator packages from GitHub and build them.
Launch the arm in the Gazebo simulator and move it from the GUI.
Connect the real arm and run the same example with it.
Try the MoveIt 2 example to plan your first pick and place.
meta: Open Board. From $1,417. A few stores.
